Fed & Policy Watch
  • Beige Book is listed today, but its time conflicts: Federal Reserve Board calendar says 2:00 PM ET; Chicago Fed calendar says 3:00 PM ET. Omitted from the timed calendar pending resolution; do not rely on either time without rechecking publishers.
  • Board statistical releases are assigned only to their own October day lists. H.4.1 is scheduled Thursday at 4:30 PM ET; H.8 is Friday, not Thursday. The calendar shows selected Fed statistical releases, not every release.
  • Thursday's 8:30 AM cluster is Census retail sales, Chicago Fed NFCI, and Philadelphia Fed manufacturing survey; EIA petroleum data follows at noon. The 17-Week bill auction cutoff is today at 11:30 AM.
  • NY Fed Empire State overview describes publication "at or shortly after 8:30 a.m." but does not provide an exact clock time; it is not shown as a timed row.
  • SIFMA lists Columbus Day, Oct 12, as a U.S. fixed-income market holiday. Treasury's latest curve is Tue Oct 13 at 5.21%; the prior available observation is Fri Oct 9 at 5.24%.
Omissions and Watch
  • BLS was excluded by operator decision dated Oct 11, 2026. No BLS site or mirror was requested; CPI, PPI and other BLS events are not verified or shown.
  • Date conflict check: the current NAR page reports September existing-home sales on Oct 13 and says October sales are scheduled for Nov 12 at 10:00 AM ET. No Oct 14 NAR release is listed.
  • Chicago Fed and Federal Reserve Board calendars disagree on today's Beige Book release time (3:00 PM vs 2:00 PM ET); no timed calendar row is published. NY Fed Empire State source gives only "at or shortly after 8:30 a.m.", not an exact time, so no timed row is listed.
  • EIA natural-gas schedule states its standard Thursday time but supplies no date-specific entry for Oct 14-20; no release is inferred from cadence. BEA schedule checked; no release verified in this date window.
  • TreasuryDirect confirms Oct 19 13- and 26-week bill auctions and Oct 20 6-week bill auction, but no cutoff or offering amount is posted; these are date-only. Oct 14 and Oct 15 bill cutoffs and offerings are posted.
  • Sources checked: Federal Reserve Board October calendar and H.4.1 page; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI CSV; Census 2026 calendar; TreasuryDirect auctions; U.S. Treasury daily curve; NY Fed SOFR and Empire State overview; Philadelphia Fed survey calendar; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; BEA schedule; NAR; and SIFMA holiday schedule. Market snapshot quotes are single-source Yahoo Finance. No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this does not imply no such risk exists.
  • Yahoo quotes are vendor observations, not official settlement data. Generic ES=F is not contract-bound. Confirm active contract, current market conditions, depth, applicable hours, and event updates before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Use the 2:10 AM ET generic ES=F observation as overnight context only. MOVE is moderate; the latest official 10Y close is 5.21%. Track the 10:00 AM Census release, 11:30 AM Treasury bill cutoff, unresolved Beige Book time, and Thursday's 8:30 AM data cluster plus noon EIA report. Scenario framework only; not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break with confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility, and market depth, or if the applicable contract's hours differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes and resolve event-time discrepancies before execution.
